# statusdrift_notification_channel (Data Source)

Fetches a single notification channel by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the notification channel.
- `name` (String) The name of the notification channel.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification channel is enabled.
- `type` (String) The type of the notification channel (email, slack, webhook, etc.).
